title: AI modeling and thermal proteomics identify ACLY as a demethylzeylasteral target
summary: A structure-aware graph neural network (HoloGNN) combined with thermal proteomics identified ACLY as a direct target of demethylzeylasteral. Orthogonal assays gave an SPR KD of 9.86 uM and an enzymatic IC50 of 3.91 uM, and the compound reduced imiquimod-induced psoriasiform dermatitis in mice. This is a preprint and the GNN contribution is not separated from the proteomics.
ai_technology: Structure-aware graph neural network (HoloGNN) with thermal proteomics
organization: Agricultural Genomics Institute at Shenzhen, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences, Shenzhen, China; Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, China

evidence.tested: SPR and enzyme assays, in vitro cell work and an in vivo psoriasis model.
evidence.unknown: How much the GNN, rather than the proteomics, contributed to target identification; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A graph neural network helped prioritize the ligand target candidates.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from the review input and author affiliations from Crossref metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
